blog.title: how to rush B (a guide from a guy who has done it 4,000 times)
blog.body: step 1. buy armor. the vest. not the helmet. you'll thank me. step 2. check the clock. it doesn't matter. check it anyway. step 3. count in your head. 3. 2. 1. you're already going. step 4. do not stop. stopping is how you die. step 5. if there's a smoke, go through the smoke. smoke is just a door that argues. step 6. do not look at your teammates. look at B. step 7. if the whole team rushes you will all arrive together, which is the whole plan and also the whole problem. step 8. plant. step 9. if you die, say gg. the guy who got you is somebody's kid and probably also waiting for his mom to call him for dinner. step 10. repeat. 4,000 times. you'll get 61%. nobody knows why. i stopped asking in the spring.

blog.title: why the new guy gets the AWP (a short one)
blog.body: people ask. so here it is. the first time i ever got a headshot with the AWP, it was a lucky one. i had zoomed in on a door for 2 minutes. a guy walked into the door. bang. he fell. i did not breathe for about thirty seconds. i sat there with the zoom still on, looking at an empty doorway like it was a painting. nobody told me i could keep the feeling. so i make sure every new guy gets one round. they will miss. that's fine. they will shoot a wall. that's fine. but one in ten hits, and when it does i look over and i can see them forget how to breathe. that's the whole rule. that's why it's a rule. that, and the AWP is $4750 and i'm not buying it for myself.
